claims.text: Treetops Lodge & Estate is located 20 minutes from Rotorua, in secluded countryside in New Zealand's central North Island.

findings.quote: Treetops Lodge & Estate is located 20 minutes from Rotorua, in a piece of secluded countryside in New Zealand

claims.text: The estate is reserved exclusively for guests.
